What this covers

Bronze is built and running on the portal

A member signs in once, works through the Bronze lessons, passes the final quiz, and prints an LDAH certificate — all inside ldahawaii.org.

  • Where it lives — the member portal, alongside events, videos and screening results
  • What's done — Bronze: Welcome, four lessons, a pop quiz, and the final quiz
  • What's next — Silver and Gold, using Laʻa's existing content
  • What it replaces — the Kajabi course site
The reason for the move

Kajabi is a bill and a second front door

The course content is excellent. The platform underneath it is rented, separate from our site, and charging us every year.

Kajabi today

  • $1,400 a year, ongoing
  • A second login for families to remember
  • Members leave ldahawaii.org to take the course
  • Look and feel set by the platform, not by LDAH
  • Completion data sits outside our member records

On the member portal

  • No platform subscription
  • The same login members already use
  • Members stay on our site the whole way through
  • Our branding, our accessibility work, our wording
  • Progress and certificates stored with the member record

The training content itself does not change — this is about where it lives.

Step one

It's just another tile on the portal

No new address, no new password. Members find the program next to their events, screening results and videos.

Step two

The whole path is visible from the start

The left rail is the syllabus. Bronze is open; Silver and Gold show as locked so families can see where the path leads.

Step three

Progress saves itself, on any device

Green checks and a completion bar. Close the browser mid-lesson, come back next week on a phone, and the course is exactly where it was.

  • Per member — progress is tied to their portal account, not to one browser
  • Per lesson — a check appears the moment a lesson is completed
  • Quizzes — the pop quiz is a quick check; the final quiz unlocks the certificate
  • Visible to staff — completion lives with the member record, not on another company's server
Step four

The certificate issues itself

Pass the final quiz and the Bronze certificate appears on the dashboard — named, numbered and dated. No staff step in between.

What the family keeps

A real certificate, printed from the browser

  • LDAH letterhead — our logo, our wording, the island artwork from the site
  • Numbered — LDAH-B-2026-0001, so a certificate can be looked up later
  • Print or save — paper or PDF, from any browser
  • Wording is ours to set — the paragraph on the certificate is yours to approve

What I need from you

Three things, whenever you have a moment

Walk the Bronze tier

Sign in on the staging portal and work through it as a parent would. Tell me anything that reads wrong or is missing.

Approve the certificate wording

The paragraph, the tier names, and the certificate number format are all easy to change — but better to settle them before the first one goes out.

Point me at the Silver and Gold content

Once I have Laʻa's material for the next two tiers, I can build them the same way.
